answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 12 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The quill debit happens at intake, karst totals the burned amount, and jade anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm as a result pays the burn once for each alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Each impostor pays 6 dollars up front. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
